places.name: Odie B's
places.description: Fast-moving sandwich spot with one of Denvers best burgers.
places.why_it_hits:
Not just another burger joint, this is the kind of place that rewards repeat visits. On your first trip, don’t overthink it: go straight for the Double OD burger. Save the rest of the menu for next time.
The OD burger delivers exactly what you want, two perfectly smashed patties layered with american and cheddar jack, topped with dill-pickled onions and a house-made “fancy sauce,” all tucked into a soft brioche bun. It’s rich, tangy, and unapologetically satisfying, the kind of burger that sets the standard before you explore anything else.

places.name: My Brothers Bar
places.description: My Brother's Bar is a no-frills Denver institution, the city’s oldest bar, serving up classic, messy burgers in a timeless, character-filled setting that’s as much about history as it is the food.
places.why_it_hits:
An old-school spot serving up gloriously messy burgers, the kind that drip, ooze, and hit exactly right. You really can’t go wrong with a classic cheeseburger here, but the move is the Johnny Burger.
It’s a masterclass in balance: jalapeños with just enough heat, creamy pockets of cream cheese, melty american and swiss, and sweet grilled onions all piled onto a perfectly sloppy patty. It sounds like a lot—and it is—but every bite works. This is the expert order.
